Rotary Turret.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Rotary Turret.reasoning: Primary structural and wear-resistant material for rotary turret components requiring strength and corrosion resistance; industry standard in rotary tablet presses.

Rotary Turret.reasoning: Used for critical wear surfaces and guiding elements of the turret due to hardness and durability; standard in high-precision machining parts.

Rotary Turret.name: Aluminum
Rotary Turret.reasoning: Possible lightweight framing or non-critical parts in some designs; less common but used for weight reduction.
